Battlefields *{{api|AcceptBattlefieldPort(accept)}} - Called with true to accept porting into a battlefield, or false to reject/leave queue. *{{api|GetBattlefieldEstimatedWaitTime()}} - Get estimated wait for entry into the battlefield. *{{api|GetBattlefieldInfo(index)}} - Get detailed information about a battlefield. *{{api|GetBattlefieldInstanceExpiration()}} - Get shutdown timer for the battlefield instance *{{api|GetBattlefieldInstanceInfo(index)}} - Get information about a battlefield instance. *{{api|GetBattlefieldPortExpiration()}} - Get the number of milliseconds before the battlefield port expires. *{{api|GetBattlefieldStatus()}} - Get status information for the battlefield *{{api|ShowBattlefieldList()}} - Request list of available battlefield instances. ; PvP Stats *{{api|GetPVPLastWeekStats()}} - Get the statistics about your PvP contribution for last week. *{{api|GetPVPLifetimeStats()}} - Get the statistics about your lifetimes PvP contribution *{{api|GetPVPRankInfo(rank [, unit])}} - Get information about a specific rank (Second arg not used by UI) *{{api|GetPVPSessionStats()}} - Get the statistics about your PvP contribution for this session. *{{api|GetPVPYesterdayStats()}} - Get the statistics about your PvP contribution for yesterday. *{{api|UnitPVPRank("unit")}} - Return PVP rank information for a unit. *RegisterEvent("{{api|t=e|PLAYER_PVP_KILLS_CHANGED}}");
